title: Connector local settings v2
description: WebService loopback /{product_id}/internal/v2/connector-settings/ accepts GET and POST. Exact loopback Host, actual loopback peer, and X-YooDesk-Local-Management (base64 of the protected 32-byte backend key) are required. Origin and remote backend proofs are forbidden. Connector proxies through its same-origin admin API; The current access password is returned only through the protected local management read response; it is never included in capability reports or public snapshots. Failed writes do not return success. Protocol/master switches restrict Connector access only. Password rotation revokes all access sessions. Errors: 400 invalid update/body, 403 rejected boundary, 405 method, 500 persistence/read failure. Connector returns 400 for unavailable upstream operations.

remote_enabled.description: Master switch. Turning it off preserves individual protocol choices.

password.description: Current access password for the authorized loopback management page only. Never forward in capability reports.
At most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Whitespace and control characters are rejected.
